summary: Houthis launched dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, while Israeli airstrikes hit Khan Younis in Gaza. Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline remains largely offline for weeks after strike damage. Iran seized assets of 240 individuals accused of collaborating with Israel and denied IRGC presence in Ali Taher tunnels, claiming only Hezbollah operatives were there.
key_points: Houthis announced launching dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait. (Source: @asafroz/53407)
Israeli aircraft conducted two strikes on Al-Barak area in southern Khan Younis, Gaza. (Source: @yediotnews25/134954)
Saudi east-west pipeline damaged in strikes will remain largely offline for several weeks during repairs. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7109)
Iran's judiciary seized assets of 240 individuals for collaboration with Israel and other hostile regimes. (Source: @presstv/206718)
Iran denies IRGC personnel in Ali Taher tunnels, states 48 Hezbollah operatives were present with 8 killed. (Source: @pkpoi/143933)
Israeli Division 80 conducted 72-hour exercise simulating Houthi sea invasion, hostages in Eilat area. (Source: @New_security8200/203790)
Chinese entities allegedly supplied Iran with satellite images of US base in Jordan used for missile strike killing three American troops. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7106)
Off-duty Israeli soldier suspended for firing at Palestinians near al-Mughayyir in West Bank after alleged stone-throwing. (Source: @manniefabian/59154)

sections.executive_summary: Houthis launched a major missile and drone barrage targeting Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, marking a significant escalation in Red Sea tensions. Simultaneously, Israeli airstrikes struck Khan Younis in southern Gaza while Saudi critical energy infrastructure remains offline weeks after attack damage. Iran intensified domestic pressure by seizing assets of 240 alleged collaborators with Israel.

points: Iran's judiciary seized assets belonging to 240 individuals accused of collaboration with Israel and other hostile regimes, according to Press TV. (Source: @presstv/206718)

Iranian media claimed a US Air Force WSO officer codenamed 'Bravo' was rescued by US special forces after his fighter was shot down in Iranian airspace, involving over 90 special operations personnel. (Source: @kianmeli1/91950)
Iran denied reports of IRGC personnel trapped in Ali Taher tunnels, stating only 48 Hezbollah operatives were present in the two attacked tunnels with 8 killed. (Source: @pkpoi/143933)
A planned meeting in Oman involving Persian Gulf foreign ministers to discuss the Strait of Hormuz was cancelled at Saudi Arabia's request, per Iranian Foreign Ministry. (Source: @presstv/206717)

Iran's representative at the IAEA General Conference in Vienna condemned Austria's denial of visas to the Iranian delegation as a clear abuse of power and violation of host country obligations. (Source: @presstv/206716)

US officials allege Chinese entities supplied Iran with high-resolution satellite images of a US air base in Jordan, which Iran used for a missile strike that killed three American troops. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7106)

Trump stated the 'Iran issue' may be resolved before US midterm elections but any war with Iran would end immediately after elections, adding Iran is 'desperate for a deal' and continuously contacting Washington. (Source: @VahidOnline/78354)

IDF Spokesperson Brig. Gen. Efi Defrin invited creators of the 'Naza' film to allow IDF representatives to view the full film for substantive response to allegations, including claims of 500 civilians killed in a single strike. (Source: @inon_yttach/10026)
Israeli aircraft conducted two strikes on a target in the Al-Barak area of southern Khan Younis, according to Gaza reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134954)

IDF denied planning or executing any Gaza strike expected to kill 500 civilians, referencing the Mohammed Deif and Rafe Salameh strike where Gaza reports claimed ~90 killed, half estimated as terrorists. (Source: @almogboker78/18185)

Israeli Division 80 conducted a 72-hour annual training exercise simulating a Houthi invasion from the sea, hostage situations, and terrorists barricaded in the Eilat area. (Source: @New_security8200/203790)

An off-duty Israeli soldier was suspended for opening fire on Palestinians near al-Mughayyir in the West Bank after allegedly coming under stone-throwing; no injuries reported from gunfire. (Source: @manniefabian/59154)
Israeli Chief of Staff in South Lebanon stated the Lebanese Army must show effectiveness on the ground or progress in the agreement will not be possible. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/391704)

Jared Kushner claimed Israel conducted the Doha strike which failed and led to Israel's international isolation, but the resulting dynamics pushed Israel toward a deal they are now 'very satisfied with.' (Source: @almogboker78/18181)
Israeli aircraft conducted two strikes on the Al-Barak area in southern Khan Younis, according to reports from Gaza. (Source: @yediotnews25/134954)

Clashes erupted in the West Bank village of al-Mughayyir between Israeli settlers who entered the village and Palestinian residents, involving stone-throwing and roadblocks. (Source: @manniefabian/59154)
IDF troops dispatched multiple times to al-Mughayyir acted to disperse confrontations and remove roadblocks, also coming under stone-throwing during the incident. (Source: @manniefabian/59154)
An off-duty soldier reported Palestinians hurled stones at him on al-Mughayyir outskirts, returned fire while no other troops were present, and was detained by police. (Source: @manniefabian/59154)
IDF stated it is unaware of any injuries caused by the off-duty soldier's gunfire in the al-Mughayyir incident. (Source: @manniefabian/59154)
Heavy gunfire reported during a clan battle in Beirut, according to uncensored security news channel. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94361)
Israeli Chief of Staff in South Lebanon emphasized the Lebanese Army must demonstrate effectiveness on the ground or the agreement cannot move forward. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/391704)
Iran claimed only Hezbollah operatives (48 total, 8 killed) were in the two attacked tunnels at Ali Taher ridge, denying IRGC presence. (Source: @pkpoi/143933)

US officials allege Chinese entities provided Iran with high-resolution satellite imagery of a US air base in Jordan, which Iran used for a missile strike killing three American troops. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7106)
Houthis announced launching dozens of ballistic missiles and suicide drones at Saudi King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait in southern Saudi Arabia. (Source: @asafroz/53407)
Yemeni armed forces claimed targeting military facilities at King Khalid Air Base including aircraft hangars, radars, runways, and ammunition depots. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90475)
Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline, damaged in strikes, will remain largely offline for several weeks while repairs are conducted, officials told AP. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7109)
Reports indicate Abha and Khamis Mushait in Saudi Arabia are under threat from Yemeni missiles and suicide drones. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90471)
A Houthi field commander, Manaa al-Ghuli, was killed during fighting with government forces in Taiz, Yemen. (Source: @shin_persian/9883)
Iran said a planned Oman meeting of Persian Gulf foreign ministers to discuss the Strait of Hormuz was cancelled at Saudi Arabia's request. (Source: @presstv/206717)

sections.threat_assessment: The Houthi missile and drone barrage on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base represents a significant escalation in Red Sea conflict dynamics, directly threatening Gulf energy infrastructure as evidenced by the prolonged pipeline shutdown. Iran's asset seizures of 240 alleged collaborators signals intensified internal repression alongside external pressure campaigns. The alleged Chinese provision of targeting intelligence to Iran for strikes on US forces in Jordan indicates deepening strategic coordination between Beijing and Tehran with direct lethal consequences for American personnel. Israeli operations continue across Gaza and the West Bank while facing international scrutiny over civilian casualty allegations.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia requested cancellation of the Oman-hosted Gulf foreign ministers meeting on Strait of Hormuz, signaling Riyadh's reluctance to engage diplomatically with Tehran amid active Houthi attacks on Saudi territory. Austria's visa denial to Iran's IAEA delegation triggered formal Iranian protests at the Vienna conference, highlighting deteriorating Iran-Europe diplomatic channels. The Lebanese Army faces explicit Israeli pressure to demonstrate 'effectiveness on the ground' in southern Lebanon, testing Beirut's capacity to implement security arrangements under Israeli oversight.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Division 80 exercise simulating Houthi sea invasion of Eilat reveals Israeli military planning for direct Yemeni threats to its southern territory, beyond proxy conflicts. Iranian media's detailed claims of a US pilot rescue operation behind enemy lines — involving 90+ special forces — may signal strategic messaging about US vulnerability or actual operational exposure. The 'Naza' film controversy and IDF's demand to view it suggests Israeli concern over narrative warfare regarding civilian casualty allegations. Houthi commander elimination in Taiz indicates ongoing Yemeni government counter-operations despite Red Sea escalation.
